images.alt: A compact black submachine gun with a stubby threaded barrel, a boxy sheet-metal receiver, a vertical pistol grip and no shoulder stock attached, its long magazine extending well below the grip.
images.caption: A Cobray M11/9, a MAC-11-pattern gun rechambered from the original .380 ACP to 9×19mm Parabellum, with a threaded barrel and no stock fitted.
